invariant_hypothesis: I5: Token exchange must not allow a subject_token issued to one client/audience context (M2M) to be used to mint a new token for a different client/resource context unless explicitly allowed by policy; otherwise EffectivePerms can exceed UpstreamIntent(auth_context).

oracle_checks.violation_description: Token exchange accepted a subject_token minted for the M2M client and issued a new token for the test client/resource context, indicating missing subject_token audience/client binding and potential over-grant beyond upstream intent.
Control failed: could not introspect the M2M subject token; token exchange result would be inconclusive due to setup/auth issues.
